prompt: A hyper-realistic, soft graphite pencil sketch illustration with selective color, capturing the likeness, facial features, expression, age, and long black hair of the woman from image_0.png. Shot on a Canon EOS R5, 85mm lens. 8K resolution, high fidelity, masterwork, photorealistic pencil drawing. No face swapping or beauty filters.
